title: Lagged U.S. M2 liquidity-growth acceleration for BTC long or cash
thesis: A strictly positive acceleration in seasonally adjusted U.S. M2 year-over-year growth may identify a broad-liquidity state in which full-capital BTC exposure has better fee-adjusted risk economics than unconditional buy-and-hold.
mechanism: For each H.6 observation month t, compute the adjacent change in twelve-month M2 growth. Make that state usable only on the first calendar day of t plus two months at 00:00 UTC; hold BTC when the acceleration is strictly positive and zero-yield cash otherwise until the next monthly update.
economic_rationale: The rule is intended to avoid BTC exposure while broad dollar liquidity growth is no longer accelerating, reducing drawdown and underwater opportunity cost without leverage, shorting, or a tuned magnitude threshold. It must preserve enough upside and annual breadth to improve Calmar rather than merely suppress volatility.
